examples.label: Marion County, Indiana
examples.output:
In the Compute Atlas snapshot of October 2, 2026, Marion County, Indiana has 3 qualifying documented pipeline records: data-center site records listed as proposed, permitted or under construction with confirmed or reported confidence. Among its 40 peer counties, 33 have fewer records, 5 have the same number and 2 have more. The peer median is 1 record, the peer mean is 1.075, and 23 of the 40 peers have at least one record.

The peers were matched only on population and population density, with populations from 678,179 to 1,636,630, so Marion County is compared with places of similar population and density without using data-center activity to choose them. The comparison does not explain the count or show any effect. The figures are records in one incomplete snapshot, not verified buildings, and the comparison is descriptive, not causal or a test of statistical significance.
